scope: Proposition 7.1 (Regulator comparison) of the manuscript “Exact mass asymptotics for the two-dimensional O(4) lattice model” (preprints/Exact-mass-asymptotics-for-the-two-dimensional-O4-lattice-model-October-5-2026/exact-mass-o4.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 215 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 4eb3ab28f7565322), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 55. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: For all sufficiently large β there are b = β + O(1), r = 1 + O(β−1 ), cx, ct = β + O(1), ϕ ∈ R, and a bulk volume scalar for each regulator, independent of the periods and of the time seam, with the following property. Remove these scalars from the partition functions. For dyadic lengths mx ≍ β(log β)2 , mt ≍ p β(log β)4 , and also with mt replaced by 2mt, the Brownian regulator of heat time r/b per fine horizontal cell, hence circumference W = (r/b)LN mx, satisfies ZB ± = Z F(ϕ) ± + O(e−cβ )Z F(0) + . (7.1) Here c > 0 and the implicit constants are independent of β and these periods. The same scalar for a given regulator is used for both seams and both temporal lengths.
